recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central circular portrait of four people, framed by a thick orange border and set against a black background with bold, diagonally oriented display typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame containing a group portrait against a dark background
Diagonal text blocks mirroring each other's angle in the upper quadrants
Thick outer border color-matched to the circular frame's inner rings
Warm, saturated lighting on subjects contrasting with deep black negative space
coreInvariants: Warm orange and yellow accent colors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a triangular cluster within a central circle, occupying approximately 60% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular portrait acts as the primary anchor, supported by the thick orange outer frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, move down through the faces in the circle, and exit through the top-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black in the corners outside the circle to emphasize the central subjects and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange used for the outer border and circular frame rings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy white for the typography and warm skin tones within the portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange elements; high value contrast between the white text and black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, high-contrast sans-serif with flared terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Flared, almost wedge-like terminals on vertical stems
Uniform diagonal baseline tilt of approximately 30 degrees
characterSpecificRedesigns: S-curves are extremely tight and blocky
Terminals on 'E' and 'L' are sharp and angled
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display text to maintain 70s graphic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared terminals and high-contrast vertical weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick orange outer border. The center should feature a large circle containing a group portrait of four people with 70s hairstyles and clothing, set against a dark brown studio backdrop. The area outside the circle but inside the border must be solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of text in the upper left and upper right corners. Use an extra-bold, high-contrast sans-serif font in cream white. Tilt the text blocks at a 30-degree angle, following the curve of the central circle.

verificationChecks: Is the text tilted at a consistent diagonal angle?
Is the central portrait contained within a perfect circle?
Is the outer border a thick, solid orange?
Is the background outside the circle pure black?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the circle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any logos or record label branding
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the thick orange outer border
Ensure the central mask is a clean circle
Confirm the font weight is 'Black' or 'Extra Bold'
recipe.reuseFormula: Square format + Thick border + Central circular mask + Diagonal bold sans-serif typography in upper corners.
